author: 9to5Google
description:
The Pixel 11 Pro Fold brings a handful of meaningful upgrades, including a thinner and lighter design, brighter inner display, improved hinge, new 48MP cameras, and up to 120x Pro Zoom. But with the battery capacity dropping to 4,750mAh, is this really a worthwhile upgrade over the Pixel 10 Pro Fold?
